column1: # Findings of the fuzz target in library code that are reported and not fixed yet (tests/Regex.Fuzz/README.md,
# "Known findings"). A session prints a finding listed here as known and does not fail on it; a declared session that
# no longer reaches a listed finding fails, as stale; FuzzTargetTests runs each reproduction and fails once it no longer
# reproduces. So the row leaves this file in the change that fixes its defect, and in no other.
# Columns, tab-separated: kind, exception type, the innermost library method on its stack, a text its message holds,
# the reproduction as a JSON string and its flags (letters, or - for none), and who reported it when, with the seed and
# the iteration that first found it. A finding is the row's only when all of the first four agree, so that another
# exception of the type from the same method is reported.
